sources.entry: Ao - Elegant Microsoft To-Do desktop app.

summary.one_liner: Ao is an unofficial, open source desktop app for Microsoft To-Do with themes, compact mode, and customizable keyboard shortcuts.
summary.what_it_does: Ao is a community-built desktop client for Microsoft To-Do, described as unofficial and not affiliated with Microsoft. It offers Black, Dark, and Sepia themes, plus an Auto Night Mode that adjusts to the environment. A Compact Mode shrinks the window, and a scalable interface lets you zoom text larger or smaller. Users can navigate lists with Cmd/Ctrl Tab or jump to lists 1-9. The README lists 40+ local shortcuts (for example, toggling My Day, Important, Planned, and the sidebar) and three global shortcuts for creating a todo, searching, or toggling the window. Shortcuts are customized through a ~/.ao.json file, and update-check frequency is configurable.
use_cases: manage Microsoft To-Do tasks on desktop
keep to-do lists in a compact floating window
quick-add todos from anywhere with global shortcuts
use a dark or sepia theme for task lists
navigate between To-Do lists using the keyboard
how_to_run: Download the installer for your system from the GitHub releases page
macOS: brew cask install ao (README notes this version may be outdated)
Developers: clone the fork, run npm install (or yarn install)
Run in dev mode with npm start (or yarn start)
Build binaries and installers with npm run release (or yarn release)
stack: Electron (implied by desktop app build; not named in README)
notable: Unofficial Microsoft To-Do client with Black, Dark, and Sepia themes
Local and global customizable keyboard shortcuts via ~/.ao.json
Compact mode and auto night mode
Available via GitHub releases, Snapcraft, and Homebrew Cask
Sister apps listed: Tusk (Evernote) and Taskbook (command line)
caveats: Unofficial, third-party app with no affiliation to Microsoft
Homebrew Cask version may lag behind the latest release; GitHub releases recommended
Snap is the only channel the README says is officially maintained
